news.title: Luxury real estate boom in Andheri East as JB Nagar seals a ₹10 crore home deal
news.para: Spread across approximately 3.5 acres, Chandak Sarvam offers thoughtfully planned 2, 3 and 4 BHK residences, complemented by landscaped open spaces, lifestyle amenities and recreational zones.

news.title: Gulshan Group, Ourika Estates to invest over ₹750 crore in Ghaziabad, Lucknow housing projects
news.para: Gulshan Group and Ourika Estates have formed a development platform that will invest over ₹750 crore across two residential projects in Ghaziabad and Lucknow. The developments will have a combined built-up area of about 1.5 million sq ft.

news.title: Thirteen PGs, seven scrap shops shut after failing Pune civic body's fire safety checks
news.para: Pune's authorities undertook a comprehensive sweep to assess fire safety and civic compliance, shutting down thirteen paying guest lodges and seven scrap businesses due to inadequate fire protection and missing permits. The city officials are actively sealing unauthorized operations and pursuing legal action against those failing to meet essential safety standards, emphasizing the commitment to uphold public safety measures.

news.title: Goa's property boom hits a realty check
news.para: Goa's real estate market is stabilizing after a significant boom period.  Sales and enquiries for second homes have slowed considerably over the past year.  North Goa experienced a price correction, while smart capital moves to emerging pockets.  Established developers are strengthening their position as buyers seek reliable track records.  South Goa is increasingly recognized for its peaceful coastal living and refined lifestyle.

news.title: Chalet Hotels in advanced talks to buy Six Senses Vana for ₹600 crore
news.para: Chalet Hotels is on the verge of acquiring Six Senses Vana in Dehradun, a luxurious wellness retreat owned by Veer Singh, son of Analjit Singh. Valued at roughly 600 crore rupees, this deal highlights Chalet's commitment to expanding its footprint in the high-end hospitality market while concurrently developing other upscale properties throughout India.

news.title: Bengaluru development body's new fees put property owners on edge
news.para: In Bengaluru, property owners must brace for heightened costs associated with online civic services due to newly implemented software fees. A two hundred rupee fee will be applicable to residential properties, while others will be charged one thousand rupees. Furthermore, there are notable increases in khata conversion and registration fees across all categories of properties. These charges aim to bolster software development and improve infrastructure.

news.title: Developer in Bhopal booked after resident claims hidden pipeline to route sewage overflow
news.para: A colony builder stands accused of illicitly diverting sewage into a borewell, leading to severe groundwater pollution and raising significant health alarms for the local community. In response to numerous complaints, officials promptly inspected the site, sealing the borewell to prevent further contamination. The municipal corporation has issued a formal notice addressing the environmental violations, igniting an ongoing investigation into the sewer disposal practices at hand.

news.title: Global hotel chains on expansion spree in Jaipur, sign up for 40 properties
news.para: Jaipur's hospitality landscape is set for a transformation with more than forty large hotel developments underway. This surge in properties aims to support the booming destination wedding sector, particularly along the significant Jaipur-Delhi highway. Acclaimed global and local hospitality chains are making substantial investments in these new ventures, which will noticeably boost both branded room availability and market competition in the area.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh cabinet clears Lucknow development body's plan to release 2,747 mortgaged Sushant Golf City plots
news.para: The state cabinet has greenlit the Lucknow Development Authority's initiative for Sushant Golf City, ensuring that registries for 2,747 mortgaged plots remain intact, thus safeguarding the interests of buyers. Despite Ansal Properties' sale of these plots without necessary approvals, the LDA is set to complete the township's development and will release plots sector by sector. Plot owners may expedite their process by submitting a guarantee to the LDA.

news.title: Chandigarh administration's estate office to re-auction eight residential properties in October
news.para: In October, Chandigarh's estate office is set to auction ten residential properties. Eight of these plots went unsold in the June auction due to lack of interest. The reserve prices will be maintained based on current collector rates. Officials are optimistic that the festive season will draw in more bidders this time around. Efforts for advertisements and enhanced publicity are currently in progress.

news.title: PG association seeks policy to regulate 10,000-plus paying guest facilities in Gurugram
news.para: In Gurugram, PG operators are calling for a specialized policy to address the needs of long-term guests, as current guesthouse regulations fall short. They emphasize the necessity for registration and the establishment of safety protocols for PG accommodations. Noting the absence of government-managed housing options, operators aim for a structured approach to enhance the safety of residents and support both staff and management in this vital sector.

news.title: BMC to crack down on 39,111 unauthorised slum structures in Mumbai from October 1
news.para: The BMC will launch a three-month special drive from October 1 against unauthorised constructions in slum areas, targeting 39,111 structures measuring 14ft or more in height. The civic body has urged residents to voluntarily remove unauthorised portions before enforcement teams begin demolition action.

news.title: Bombay HC cancels registration of separate society for two wings of Prabhadevi building
news.para: Justice Sandeep Marne on Friday said it was “wholly impermissible” for residents of A and B wings to directly approach the deputy registrar under Section 9 (registration) of the Maharashtra Cooperative Societies Act “for registration of a new society in respect of a building for which there already exists another housing society.”

news.title: After Calcutta high court order, CBI starts probe into illegal constructions
news.para: Following a court mandate, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has launched an inquiry into illegal building practices in Kolkata. Searches took place at four sites in Rajabazar over the weekend, revealing serious claims of crores being invested in unauthorized high-rises. Around fifty illicit constructions have been spotted in numerous areas of the city. The court expects a comprehensive report from the agency by October 14.

news.title: Lucknow development body shifts Narmada project to CG City, renames it Nautica Greens
news.para: The Lucknow Development Authority is shifting its Narmada Apartments initiative to the Nautica Greens site. This upgraded housing project will include five 28-storey towers in proximity to Ekana Stadium. With 500 three-bedroom-plus-study flats and 20 lavish penthouses, existing allottees will retain their allocations at no extra cost. For those who choose not to participate, refunds plus interest will be issued.

news.title: Ashiana Housing eyes ₹2,400 crore sales bookings, over ₹1,000 crore land acquisitions in FY27
news.para: Ashiana Housing expects sales bookings in FY27 to remain around last year's ₹2,400 crore level while targeting more than ₹1,000 crore towards land acquisitions, Vishal Gupta, managing director, Ashiana Housing, told ETRealty. The company is also looking to increase senior living bookings to about ₹750 crore this year.

news.title: National Land Monetisation Corporation proposes monetising assets valued over ₹5,000 crore
news.para: The National Land Monetisation Corporation Limited announced plans to monetise surplus assets worth over five thousand crore rupees. These assets include lands and buildings owned by central public sector enterprises and governmental bodies. This initiative aims to generate funds for increased expenditures during the ongoing fiscal year. The corporation collaborates with asset holders to streamline the monetisation process through transparent discussions and efficient mechanisms.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh CM distributes house site deeds to over 28,000 families
news.para: Through the distribution of title deeds to 28,445 families, 399 acres of land is being regularised, encompassing over 19.3 lakh sq yards of area and ending a four-decade-long wait for ownership rights. Naidu personally handed over some title deeds to the beneficiaries.

news.title: CGST searches real estate developer's premises in Gurugram; ₹117 crore GST recovered
news.para: Documentary and digital evidence indicating alleged suppression of taxable supplies and cash dealings through a network of brokers and channel partners was also seized, it said.

news.title: Supertech insolvency: NCLAT raises concern over delay in appointing IRP, slippage on deadline
news.para: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) has directed NCLT and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) to suggest names within a week. The IRP, once named, is also required to head the Apex Court Committee overseeing the stalled Supertech projects and chair the Project-Wise Court Committee.
